integrity: Analytical finite-dimensional proof with independent direct-matrix numerical corroboration. Scientific priority assessed provisionally; independent assessment has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to an open uniform path of p−1 sites with p an odd prime at least 5, exactly two hard-core particles, and one adjacent-pair-to-vacuum loss jump at boundary sites 1,2. Does not determine finite-time rates, composite-path classifications, multiple sinks, or heterogeneous hopping.
title: An arithmetic dark-state law for two hard-core particles with one pair-loss bond
